title: Let the body learn surrender first
summary: Devotion becomes real when the body enters surrender. Let surrender reach the body before speech negotiates.
takeaway: Let surrender reach the body before speech negotiates.
lifeApplication: When ego starts bargaining, bow or soften the body first so devotion becomes more than admiration.
